noContext.none: No active work context yet. When an organization invites you to its team and adds you, your work records opens here.
noContext.pending: You have a pending invitation. Open your dashboard to accept it — then the owner can add you to the organization.
noContext.pendingNamed: You have a pending invitation from {org}. Open your dashboard to accept it — then the owner can add you to the organization.
noContext.roster: You've accepted and you're on the team roster. The organization owner still needs to add you to the organization before you can log work here.
noContext.rosterNamed: You're on {org}'s team roster. The organization owner still needs to add you to the organization before you can log work here.

reviewNotEnabledNote: Review is not enabled yet. You can log your work now — but for entries to be confirmed, the organization owner needs to enable journal review for you.
whatDidYouDo: What are you showing about your work today?
textPlaceholder: e.g. Studied 2 hours and finished a school project. Or knitted 3 pairs of socks and photographed them. Or worked 6 hours, handled 12 customer requests and prepared a report.
strengthensHint: Once you confirm it, this entry can strengthen this skill
skillNoMatch: No clearly related skills found — add skills manually.
reasonWeak: Weak signal — confirm if it fits.
newSkillIntro: These skills aren't in your profile yet. Your entry mentioned them — you can add one as a awaiting confirmation skill.
newSkillError: Couldn't add it. Please try again later.
freeTextLead: Describe your work freely: quantities, time, location. The system suggests a structure — it becomes fact only once you confirm.
example1: Worked 6 hours, helped customers, and handled 12 requests.
example2: Prepared a client proposal and aligned the project plan.
example3: Studied 2 hours, finished a school project, and presented it in class.
example4: Led a team, assigned tasks, and checked the result.
savedBody: Your confirmed details were added to your work history.
savedBodyWithDetails: Saved to your work history with {count} structured detail(s).
whoCanConfirm: Entries are visible only to you.
pilotBackboneNote: Your entries are private until you choose otherwise. The confirmation layer is shown only when there is a real confirmation.

projectContext.title: Project context
projectContext.body: Entries in this work journal will be linkable to a project once the project layer is enabled. The structure is ready, but linking is not active yet and nothing is filled automatically.

quantitySummaryHint: Optional quick summary — you can also write all quantities and units in the description above.
connectsLater: This entry can later connect to skills and confirmations

entry.deleteConfirm: Really delete this entry? It becomes soft-deleted — the row stays in history but won't show in the list.
entry.deleteBlocked: Entry already confirmed — send a correction request instead of deleting.

editEntryBanner: You're editing a saved entry. Suggest the structure again, confirm what you're changing, then "Update entry" replaces the old version. To back out —
editPreservedTitle: Kept from the previous entry (you can change it):

inbox.clarifyHint: Some parts are unclear — ask the worker to clarify the hours or works. The system does not guess.
inbox.clarifyHoursIntro: Hours unclear: the system found several time fragments and cannot tell which work they belong to.
inbox.clarifySuggestionPrefix: Please clarify how many hours you spent on each of these works:
inbox.clarifyGeneric: Please clarify which works you did and how much time you spent on each.
inbox.noSkillsRecognized: The system hasn't recognized any skills in this entry yet. You can approve the entry itself, or ask the worker to clarify the work.
inbox.writeConcreteWorks: Tip: write concrete words about what was done — e.g. taught a lesson, knitted socks, sold 5 items, volunteered 3 hours, painted walls.
inbox.confirmSkillsHint: Pick the declared skills this entry proves — they become verified.
inbox.projectNote: Entries can be linked to a project — the data model is ready, but no entry is linked yet and nothing is filled automatically. The projects / sites / client layer is filled in a separate slice.

reviewClarity.lead: Your review turns a worker's self-declared entry into confirmed evidence. Only a manager, owner, or client manager can do it — every confirmation is a real human decision.
reviewClarity.approveMeans: Confirm entry — it becomes confirmed evidence for the worker.
reviewClarity.confirmSkillsMeans: Confirm skills — also marks the picked declared skills as verified.
reviewClarity.requestChangesMeans: Request changes — sends it back; it stays self-declared until updated.
reviewClarity.rejectMeans: Reject — it stays the worker's own self-declared record, not confirmed.

inbox.emptyNext: Entries appear here when a worker you manage submits one for review.

result.approved: Entry confirmed — it's now confirmed evidence in the worker's journal.
result.changesRequested: Changes requested — the worker sees this in their journal and can update the entry.
result.notAuthorized: You are not allowed to review this entry.
result.rejected: Not confirmed — the entry stays the worker's own self-declared record in their journal.
result.reviewNotEnabled: Review is not enabled for this worker yet.

inbox.title: Entries to confirm

quick.title: Quick confirm
quick.subtitle: One glance, one tap: the card shows the worker, the date, the works and the exact skills your tap confirms. Every confirmation is your real decision, recorded only when you tap.
quick.entryOnlyNote: No unconfirmed skills — the tap confirms the entry itself.
quick.rejectedCard: Rejected — {name}. The entry stays self-declared in the worker's journal.
quick.batchSummaryLead: One confirmation covers every entry listed below and is recorded as your decision for each of them. Review the list before confirming.
quick.batchFailed: Could not confirm: {count} — open the detailed review.
quick.excludedNote: {count, plural, =0 {All exceptions reviewed — the whole list will be confirmed.} one {# entry with an exception will NOT be confirmed until you mark it reviewed.} other {# entries with exceptions will NOT be confirmed until you mark them reviewed.}}
quick.outcomeNotAcknowledged: not confirmed — the exception was left unreviewed

listEmpty: You don't have any work records yet — your entries will show up here.
listEmptyNext: Create your first entry below — it stays private until you confirm it.
navSubtitle: Show what you did — it strengthens your work card.
composerBenefit: This entry strengthens your work card.
noEngagement: You don't have an active work context yet. Join an organization or project to build your CV.
saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
notesRequiredCopy: Describe what you worked on — the free text is the records of record.
reviewMetaNote: Private entry · you review the suggestions. Manager / client confirmation comes later.

fragment.unknownHint: The system recognised a duration but not the work itself. Add a short description — the label stays private until a human confirmation step is added.
fragment.unknownClarifyPrompt: Enter a short label so this fragment can be confirmed. Without a clarification it will stay unexplained in the list.
fragment.unresolvedUnknownsBanner: {count} fragment(s) still need a clarification. You can save the entry without them, but adding a label helps anyone reviewing this entry later understand the context.

self_progress.awaitingHint: These skills have no confirmed journal entries yet. Add an entry that mentions the relevant work — suggestions will appear here, and your confirmations will build the records base.
self_progress.title: You have {n} skills

photo.label: Work photo (optional)
photo.freeTierNote: You can attach 1 photo per entry for free. More photos and extended records will be a VIP feature.
photo.invalidFile: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
photo.limitReached: This entry already has a photo — the free tier allows 1 photo per entry.
photo.notReady: Photo storage is not provisioned in this environment yet — the entry was saved without the photo.
photo.prepared: Photo resized and ready to upload.
photo.tooLargeAfter: The photo is still too large. Try a different photo.
photo.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. The entry was saved — try attaching the photo again later.
